title: Multistage Defer Trees for Hybrid Interpretability: If at First You Can't Succeed, Tree Again
abstract: arXiv:2606.30995v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has shown that well-optimized individual decision trees can match complex black box models in some settings, primarily in noisy domains. For the remaining settings, however, complex ensembled compositions of trees often achieve higher accuracy at the cost of interpretability, leaving practitioners with difficult modeling decisions along an accuracy-interpretability tradeoff. Ideally, we would like to classify as much of the data as possible with one or a small number of trees, achieving interpretability for most samples while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy. We introduce Multistage Defer Trees: a sequence of sparse decision trees that each make predictions for most samples, while deferring a small proportion to the next tree in the sequence or, ultimately, to a black box. We demonstrate that we can train this model class to match the performance of complex tree-based ensembles while routing most samples through only

translated_title: 用于混合可解释性的多阶段延迟树：若首次未能成功，那就再“树”一次
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，经过良好优化的单个决策树在某些场景下（主要是在噪声较大的领域）可以匹敌复杂的黑盒模型。然而，对于其余场景，复杂的树集成组合通常以牺牲可解释性为代价来获得更高的准确率，使从业者在准确率与可解释性之间的权衡上面临艰难的建模决策。理想情况下，我们希望用一棵或少量树尽可能多地对数据进行分类，在保持最先进准确率的同时，为大多数样本实现可解释性。我们提出了多阶段延迟树：由稀疏决策树组成的序列，其中每棵树对大多数样本进行预测，同时将一小部分样本延迟交给序列中的下一棵树，或最终交给黑盒模型。我们证明可以训练这一模型类别，使其匹配复杂树集成的性能，同时将大多数样本仅通过……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 提出多阶段延迟树，通过一列稀疏决策树对大多数样本进行可解释预测，仅将少数困难样本延迟给后续树或黑盒模型，从而在匹配复杂树集成准确率的同时实现混合可解释性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Multistage Defer Trees, a sequence of sparse decision trees that interpretably classify most samples while deferring a small portion to subsequent trees or ultimately a black box, matching the accuracy of complex tree ensembles while preserving hybrid interpretability.
